 --> Shah Rukh Khan, Deepika Padukone to shoot grand song for King in Mumbai from October 26: Report
 Shah Rukh Khan and Deepika Padukone are set to reunite for a grand song sequence in King. The preparations for the song has been underway for a week-long shoot in Mumbai. 
 Gayatri Rani 
 October 23, 2026 / 13:53 IST Share --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 Deepika Padukone and Shah Rukh Khan to resume shoot for King 
 Shah Rukh Khan and Deepika Padukone will soon start filming a song for King as part of a grand song sequence to be shot in Mumbai. The song is likely to include the full cast.
 The song will be choreographed by Vaibhavi Merchant.
 According to Variety India, the preparations are in progress for the shoot, which is set to begin on October 26. This will be Vaibhavi Merchant’s eighth time working with Shah Rukh Khan .
 Also Read:  Shah Rukh Khan's King 45-second promo gets CBFC certification, set to release with Ranbir Kapoor's Ramayana: Report 
 Shah Rukh and Vaibhavi have previously collaborated for Jawan.
 Related Stories
 How Priya Tendulkar died of cancer at 47 after her divorce from Karan Razdan; ex-husband said, 'Woh ... 
 When Sunny Deol spoke about his feud with Shah Rukh Khan during Darr, said, 'I tore off my jeans...' 
 Shah Rukh Khan's King 45-second promo gets CBFC certification, set to release with Ranbir Kapoor's R... 
 This will be the first time Deepika will return to the shoot after she welcomed her second daughter, Devi Padukone Singh, with Ranveer Singh.
 Previously, reports indicated that the unit could head to South Africa to shoot the song. Now, however, the shoot is set to take place in the city over the course of a week, with extensive preparations underway for it.
 King, which is scheduled to hit cinemas this Christmas, also stars Suhana Khan, Abhay Verma, Jaideep Ahlawat and Abhishek Bachchan in key roles.
 King marks the sixth film featuring Shah Rukh and Deepika together.
 More about King 
 Directed by Siddharth Anand, who also co-wrote it, King features Shah Rukh Khan, Suhana Khan, Abhishek Bachchan, Deepika Padukone , Anil Kapoor, Jackie Shroff, Rani Mukerji, Jaideep Ahlawat, Arshad Warsi and Raghav Juyal.
 Also Read:  Shah Rukh Khan's King nears completion as final song shoot begins, VFX 'almost complete': Report 
 The film is backed by Gauri Khan, Anand, and Mamta Anand under Red Chillies Entertainment and Marflix Pictures.
 King will be released during the busy Christmas 2026 window alongside the major Hollywood productions Jumanji, Avengers: Doomsday, and Dune 3.
 Gayatri Rani is a Senior-Sub Editor with over three years of experience in delivering Hollywood and Bollywood news.
